steps.step: build vN (this tree) and vN+1 (this tree plus one migration)
create the roles and the database (administrator)
install vN: migrate, require a current schema, activate
start a fake SMTP sink
start vN
seed vN through the API: invite, sign-up, verification by mail, sign-in, workspace, token
fingerprint vN's data
take the pre-upgrade snapshot (pg_dump)
stop vN: it drains and exits 0
install vN+1: migrate, require a current schema, activate
start vN+1
vN+1 kept every row of vN's tables and added its own
vN+1 serves: the token made under vN still works
the rollback gate: vN refuses the upgraded schema (exit 4)
the rollback gate: rollback.sh refuses until the snapshot is restored
stop vN+1: it drains and exits 0
restore the pre-upgrade snapshot
the restored database passes vN's protections check
roll back to vN (rollback.sh: schema current for vN, switch)
start vN again
vN's data matches the pre-upgrade fingerprint, table by table
vN serves: the token still works
stop vN: it drains and exits 0
